scenes.title: Breakout
scenes.caption: Your history is the level.
scenes.description: One ball to begin. A long streak brings a second, then a third. A gentle start, a little more momentum, and your year begins again.

scenes.title: Growing Snake
scenes.caption: Every good day makes you grow.
scenes.description: Four segments to begin. One more for every active day. Watch your year become a 142-segment snake, one small square at a time.
